summary: A generic military rocket/missile launcher truck: the cab-over truck in matte olive with a steel launch deck… joints cab_tilt, door_l, door_r, launcher, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer, …; options body, paint; sockets socket_driver, socket_tow, socket_launch, exhaust_0, launch_blast.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.missile_launcher_truck or place "prefab": "missile_launcher_truck" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
